newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat, maize steady in low volume.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat, maize steady in low volume.

text.p: Argentine wheat and maize were steady in low volume cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, traders said.

Sunny weather has allowed the maize harvest to get ahead of schedule, and some buyers are now sitting back in the hope that harvest pressure will weigh on prices. The price paid to farmers for maize in Buenos Aires was steady at $112. Bahia Blanca wheat was unchanged at $147. May soybeans rose $2 to $298 in thin volume, with the market tagging after Chicago's high Thursday close. April sunflower seed sagged $2 to $218, with demand muted.
